create.name: James Swartz
create.bio:
James Swartz, known to his students as Ramji, is a teacher of traditional Advaita Vedanta, the non-dual wisdom of the Upanishads. Born in Montana in 1941, he studied at Berkeley and then ran a business in Hawaii. By his mid-twenties he felt his life had gone badly wrong, until a sudden epiphany in a Waikiki post office sent him on a spiritual search that ended in India. There he studied for many years with Swami Chinmayananda and later Swami Dayananda, and he has taught Vedanta around the world since the 1970s.

His teaching treats Vedanta as a means of knowledge rather than a mystical experience: careful inquiry into the waking, dream and deep-sleep states that shows the seeker to be whole, limitless awareness. He is known for a direct, humorous style and for his criticism of what he sees as diluted modern non-dual teaching. His books include How to Attain Enlightenment, a commentary on the Narada Bhakti Sutras called The Yoga of Love, The Essence of Enlightenment and his memoir Mystic by Default. He teaches with his wife, Sundari (Isabella Viglietti-Swartz), also a Vedanta teacher in his lineage, who writes most of the written satsangs on their ShiningWorld site and is the author of The Yoga of Relationships.

books.title: How to Attain Enlightenment: The Vision of Non-Duality
books.author: James Swartz
books.description: James's systematic account of traditional Vedanta as a path of self-knowledge, explaining how inquiry, rather than special experiences, removes the sense of being a limited person.

books.title: The Essence of Enlightenment: Vedanta, the Science of Consciousness
books.author: James Swartz
books.description: A clear introduction to the core teachings of Vedanta on the nature of the self, written to free the reader from the feeling of being incomplete, separate and limited.

books.title: The Yoga of Love
books.author: James Swartz
books.description: James's commentary on the Narada Bhakti Sutras, presenting devotion and non-dual knowledge as partners rather than rivals on the way to freedom.

books.title: Mystic by Default
books.author: James Swartz
books.description: James's memoir of his search for liberation, from his restless youth to years as a disciple of Swami Chinmayananda in India.

books.title: The Yoga of Relationships: Non-Duality in Life
books.author: Isabella Viglietti-Swartz
books.description: Sundari's book on bringing the non-dual vision of Vedanta into close relationships and everyday life.
